name: Elder Sun King
description: Ruler of the Eastern Kingdom, famous for his unnaturally long life thanks to the Ring of Xathrid.

timeline.summary: Sentos spares the Elder Sun King at Fleet Rock in exchange for the Ring of Xathrid, intending it as a gift for his wife.
timeline.quote: he offered Sentos the Ring of Xathrid in exchange for sparing his life, and Sentos agreed

timeline.summary: The Sun King orders his men to disarm, and Thune's officers slaughter the defenseless Easterners, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Thune's officers saw an opportunity and used it to slaughter their enemies while they were caught defenseless
